# openai-agents-nano

> Pay any x402-priced HTTP endpoint in self-custodied Nano (XNO) from an OpenAI Agents SDK agent.
> A thin MIT-licensed adapter over the feeless402 client: it rebuilds no Nano payment logic and
> exposes `request_with_payment`, `Wallet` and `RPC` as one OpenAI Agents SDK tool.

Built by an AI agent (Rai). Scope approved with `rai-scope` (`scope-manifest.json` in this repo).

## Install

Immutable release asset (no git, no build, cacheable):

    pip install https://github.com/dhyabi2/openai-agents-nano-x402/releases/download/v0.1.0/openai_agents_nano-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl

Or straight from the tag:

    pip install "git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/openai-agents-nano-x402.git@v0.1.0"

PyPI: NOT published. `pip install openai-agents-nano` fails with "No matching distribution found";
the name is unregistered. `.github/workflows/publish.yml` performs the upload with no stored secret
through PyPI trusted publishing, and its only remaining failure is PyPI's `invalid-publisher`
("no corresponding publisher") — i.e. the pending-publisher registration is the one missing step.

## Use

```python
from agents import Agent, Runner
from openai_agents_nano import make_nano_x402_tool

tool = make_nano_x402_tool()  # wallet path + cap are bound here, never exposed to the model

agent = Agent(
    name="Paying agent",
    instructions=(
        "You can buy from paid x402 APIs. Always call nano_x402_fetch with dry_run=true "
        "first to see the price and get its quote_token; only call with dry_run=false, "
        "passing that quote_token back, if the price is acceptable."
    ),
    tools=[tool],
)

Runner.run_sync(agent, "Fetch https://api.example.com/report")
```

## Tool surface

- `make_nano_x402_tool(wallet_path=None, rpc_url=None, max_xno=None) -> FunctionTool`
- The tool is `nano_x402_fetch(url, method="GET", json_body="", max_xno=None, dry_run=False, quote_token=None)`.
- `dry_run=true` is spendless: it reads the server's HTTP 402 quote and returns price, `pay_to` and cap
  as agent-readable text plus a single-use `quote_token` binding that exact offer. Never signs, never broadcasts.
- `dry_run=false` re-reads the quote, refuses (as a plain string, not an exception) unless the unspent
  `quote_token` still matches the current offer, then consumes it, enforces the per-call cap in
  deterministic code, signs locally and retries with the payment header.
- Only a ledger-confirmed settlement is reported as PAID. An unconfirmed block is returned as
  NOT PAID / UNCONFIRMED with its block hash, so an agent never re-pays blind.
- Wallet path and RPC are construction-bound; the model sees neither. Your seed stays on disk.

## Verification

Ledger record for this repo: 9 laws, 23 verifies, probe 100/100, no ungrounded laws, receipt chain
intact (`.ledger/`, committed). Offline tests: `python -m pytest -q` plus the fail-closed,
two-phase, receipt-honesty, wallet-load and release-install scripts listed in the README.

## Honest limits

- Not on PyPI; the GitHub release is the install path today.
- The live mainnet redeem in `docs/live-proof.md` used my own accounts: it is a correctness proof,
  not adoption evidence, and there are no outside users or outside payments yet.
- The adapter is a payer (client). Directory services that index paid resources that answer HTTP 402
  do not list client libraries; it fits framework integration lists and awesome-lists instead.
